headline: Lemon Tree Hotels signs a license agreement for a new hotel in Mathura

headline: Lemon Tree Hotels reports 64% profit jump in Q2
hook: Strong profit growth for Lemon Tree
summary: Lemon Tree Hotels reported a net profit of ₹57 crore for the second quarter, marking a 64% increase compared to the previous year. Revenue for the period grew by 18%. This performance reflects sustained demand in the hospitality sector. Retail investors should note the company's ability to scale earnings alongside top-line growth.
why_it_matters: Signals robust demand and margin expansion for mid-tier hotel chains.

headline: Lemon Tree Hotels Q2 profit jumps 64% to ₹57 crore
hook: Strong double-digit growth for Lemon Tree
summary: Lemon Tree Hotels reported a consolidated net profit of ₹56.6 crore for the second quarter of FY27, marking a 63.7% increase year-on-year. Revenue from operations grew 18% to ₹361.4 crore during the same period. The company's performance reflects continued expansion in the hospitality sector.
why_it_matters: Strong earnings may boost investor sentiment for mid-tier hotel stocks.
